shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

sed -n 305,320p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; grep version node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; grep -n i18n package-lock.json | head
sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/example

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure SegmentedRadioGroup ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/ | head -30; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name "configure*.d.ts" | xargs cat

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -30; grep -rn "subscribeConfigure\|useLang\|getConfig" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; grep -n "configure\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; grep -n -i -A15 "## i18n\|configure(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/theme/useLang.d.ts components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat components/theme/useLang.js; grep -n "lang\|Lang" components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; ls components | grep -i segment; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "i18n" components/Pagination/i18n/index.js 2>/dev/null | head; ls components/Pagination 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -n "useLang\|SegmentedRadioGroup\|Pagination\|ThemeProvider" uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts | head; cat uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null; ls uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n; cat i18n/package.json | grep -n '"main"\|"module"\|"types"\|peerDep' ; ls i18n/build/esm; grep -n "setLang\|registerKeysets\|keyset\b\|keyset(\|get lang\|lang:" i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts i18n/build/esm/*.d.ts | head -20

sed -n 1,100p i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; grep -n "Params\|KeysData\|KeysetData" i18n/build/esm/types.d.ts | head; cat uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -40; cat ../../tsconfig.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n gravity package.json
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/index.js | head -40; sed -n 1,31p node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/types.d.ts; cat index.html vite.config.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,30p SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; grep -n "interface ControlGroupProps" -A20 types.d.ts; grep -n "view\|theme\|type\b\|size" Card/Card.d.ts | head; sed -n 40,70p Pagination/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/i18n/index.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n","")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
